description: Agent on Browser: keep the board honest. session-start = one line when a session opens: the board's address, or, once per project that has no board, how to make one; prompt = hand Claude the board and the protocol; after-tool = rebuild on a record edit, receipt on a publish, and a reminder when a card in progress goes quiet or logged lines were not sent (it runs after shell commands and builder agents too, because that is where most work happens); stop = one nudge per turn when work or cards are unaccounted for. The code is found through CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; the project through CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.
